description: Common input validity and role-collision guard policy for receipt parser
purpose: 라인 분류 전에 공통 가드 규칙을 적용하여 오분류를 줄인다
normalization 단계가 의미 해석이나 최종 line_type 결정을 침범하지 않도록 제한한다
item, discount, summary, noise 간 충돌을 parser 단계에서 안전하게 분리한다
store-specific pattern classification 이전에 적용 가능한 공통 유효성 검사를 정의한다
core_principles: original line_text must always be preserved
normalization must not directly assign final line_type
store-specific pattern files are the primary source of final role classification
noise must always be the final fallback

preconditions.name: preserve_raw_text
preconditions.rule: Before any normalization or alias handling, preserve original line_text and line index.

preconditions.name: preserve_traceability
preconditions.rule: Every normalized line must remain traceable to its original OCR line and coordinates.

preconditions.name: separate_raw_and_normalized
preconditions.rule: normalized_line_text must not overwrite original line_text.

role_collision_guards.name: discount_over_item
role_collision_guards.rule: If a line matches a store-specific discount pattern, it must not be classified as item_name or item_detail.

role_collision_guards.name: summary_over_item
role_collision_guards.rule: If a line matches a store-specific subtotal or total pattern, it must not be classified as item_name or item_detail.

role_collision_guards.name: summary_over_noise
role_collision_guards.rule: If a line matches a store-specific subtotal or total pattern, it must not be downgraded to noise.

role_collision_guards.name: item_detail_over_noise
role_collision_guards.rule: If a line matches a store-specific item_detail pattern, it must not be classified as noise.

role_collision_guards.name: discount_detail_over_noise
role_collision_guards.rule: If a line matches a store-specific discount_detail or receipt_discount pattern, it must not be classified as noise.

role_collision_guards.name: single_line_item_over_item_name
role_collision_guards.rule: If a line matches a single-line item_detail pattern, it must be classified as item_detail before any generic item_name fallback.

role_collision_guards.name: store_specific_role_before_common_fallback
role_collision_guards.rule: Store-specific role detection must run before generic fallback rules such as text-like item_name or noise.

normalization_guards.name: normalization_not_classification
normalization_guards.rule: Whitespace cleanup, separator normalization, alias replacement, and token cleanup may improve pattern matching but must not directly assign final line_type.

normalization_guards.name: name_cleanup_scope_limit
normalization_guards.rule: Bracket/prefix cleanup for names must only be applied to name candidates or extracted name fields, not blindly to every line.

normalization_guards.name: preserve_semantic_tags_in_raw
normalization_guards.rule: Tags such as IRC, EXM, PP, [앱], [카드쿠폰(율)] and similar semantic hints must remain visible in raw line_text.

normalization_guards.name: negative_amount_not_final_role
normalization_guards.rule: A negative amount indicates a discount candidate but does not by itself determine whether the line is discount_detail or receipt_discount.

field_extraction_guards.name: extract_only_after_role_candidate
field_extraction_guards.rule: Field extraction should be attempted after a line has a strong store-specific role candidate.

field_extraction_guards.name: qty_imputation_after_detail_match_only
field_extraction_guards.rule: qty=1 imputation must only be applied after store-specific item_detail or discount_detail match is confirmed.

field_extraction_guards.name: do_not_cast_uncertain_fields
field_extraction_guards.rule: If numeric extraction is uncertain, preserve line_type and raw texts while omitting the uncertain field.

field_extraction_guards.name: code_not_from_any_number
field_extraction_guards.rule: Do not treat arbitrary numeric substrings as code unless they satisfy store-specific code structure and detail-pattern context.

forbidden_behaviors.name: no_discount_attachment
forbidden_behaviors.reason: Discount attachment is a semantic interpreter responsibility.

forbidden_behaviors.name: no_item_object_creation
forbidden_behaviors.reason: Combining item_name, item_detail, and discount lines into final item objects belongs to semantic stage.

forbidden_behaviors.name: no_final_price_calculation
forbidden_behaviors.reason: Final price calculation is downstream semantic logic.

forbidden_behaviors.name: no_aggressive_noise_heuristics
forbidden_behaviors.reason: Heuristics such as 'non-numeric text means noise' or 'brackets mean noise' can destroy valid item_name lines.

forbidden_behaviors.name: no_forced_common_line_type_from_alias
forbidden_behaviors.reason: Keyword alias files are for candidate normalization, not final role assignment.

rules: If a line does not match any store-specific item, discount, summary, or noise pattern, assign common line_type=noise.
If a line looks product-like but store KB intentionally supports generic item_name fallback, apply that fallback before noise.
Unknown store-specific non-line roles must not be emitted as final common line_type values.

notes: discount_keyword and discount_target must not be collapsed into item_name
T / -T amount markers require amount normalization before safe classification
bottom-of-basket controls must not override valid transactional lines
single-line merged item patterns must be checked before generic text item_name fallback
receipt_discount with ':' + reference code must not be treated as item discount
fee-like lines should not be force-mapped to common line types without policy support
bracket-tag lines can still be valid item_name lines
receipt_discount and discount_detail must be separated carefully
aggregate discount lines such as 총할인액 are not item discounts

parser_requirements: all lines must preserve line_idx, line_text, and normalized_line_text
store_role may be preserved as an auxiliary field
final line_type must be one of the common line_types enum values
all lines including noise must remain available for downstream traceability
